_note: Reviewed zh gloss fixes, read by tools/pack_from_hsk.py (via tools/zh_gloss.js); keyed by the pack headword `w`. en: replaces the hsk `en` (must still equal `was`, else the upstream gloss changed and the override is stale); src cites the wording (CC-CEDICT via complete-hsk-vocabulary complete.json, which has every sense untruncated). synonyms: word groups whose glosses share a meaning the glossAltKeys comparison misses (each pair in a group becomes words[].syn). noTypedMeaning: add / remove words against the generated rule. Report: docs/ZH_GLOSS.md.
